# `particles`

Camera-facing particles simulated on the CPU. Place emitters in the editor (a `ParticleEmitter` component), or burst one from a script for hits, pickups and explosions.

```lua
function Gem.on_trigger_enter(self, other)
    particles.burst(self.entity:world_position(), 24, {
        speed = vector.create(2, 4, 0),          -- slowest and fastest (x, y)
        color = {
            { t = 0, color = Color.hex("#7fe3ff") },
            { t = 1, color = Color.rgb(1, 1, 1, 0) },
        },
    })
    self.entity:despawn()
end
```

## `particles`

Particle effects: one-shot bursts and control of `ParticleEmitter` entities.

### `particles.burst`

```luau
function particles.burst(position: vector, count: number, options: ParticleEmitterPatch?): Entity
```

Spawns a one-shot burst of `count` particles at `position` (world space) and returns its emitter entity, which despawns itself when the last particle dies. `options` patches the `ParticleEmitter` fields (speed, colours, size, lifetime, gravity and so on).

### `particles.start`

```luau
function particles.start(emitter: Entity)
```

Starts (or resumes) emitting.

### `particles.stop`

```luau
function particles.stop(emitter: Entity)
```

Stops emitting; live particles finish their lives.

### `particles.restart`

```luau
function particles.restart(emitter: Entity)
```

Clears the emitter's particles and starts it again from the beginning (bursts included).

### `particles.count`

```luau
function particles.count(emitter: Entity): number
```

How many particles are alive.

### `particles.is_finished`

```luau
function particles.is_finished(emitter: Entity): boolean
```

True when a non-looping emitter has finished emitting and every particle has died.
